candidates.hypothesis: Repair duplicated/contradictory relational operators in compound IF/EVALUATE conditions.
Expand abbreviated combined relation conditions without corrupting operands.
Tokenize nested/multidimensional subscripts and arithmetic index expressions.
Parse COBOL reference modification start:length without leaking COBOL tokens.
Parse INSPECT BEFORE/AFTER INITIAL and replacement clauses.
Implement INSPECT REPLACING ALL/LEADING/FIRST semantics.
Parse STRING DELIMITED BY with multiple senders and receivers.
Support UNSTRING with multiple delimiters and ALL semantics.
Repair nested inline PERFORM block boundaries and indentation.
Parse EVALUATE ALSO multi-subject WHEN tuples.
Correct INITIALIZE REPLACING category and edited-category handling.
Correct INITIALIZE over nested OCCURS and OCCURS DEPENDING ON.
Honor WITH FILLER without breaking group storage layout.
Preserve shared storage semantics for REDEFINES during moves and initialization.
Correct numeric/alphanumeric MOVE conversion and truncation rules.
Preserve COBOL decimal scale and intermediate arithmetic precision.
Implement ROUNDED and ON SIZE ERROR across arithmetic verbs.
Correct DIVIDE quotient/remainder and zero-divisor behavior.
Enforce one-based COBOL subscripts and occurrence bounds.
Correct SEARCH ALL binary search key and index behavior.
Implement SEARCH serial scan, VARYING, AT END and WHEN.
Resolve static CALL targets and argument passing.
Implement BY REFERENCE argument mutation and aliasing.
Implement BY CONTENT copy semantics.
Bind LINKAGE SECTION and PROCEDURE DIVISION USING arguments.
Correct OPEN INPUT/OUTPUT/EXTEND/I-O state and file status.
Correct READ/WRITE record transfer and EOF behavior.
Fix PERFORM THRU, paragraph return and nested control flow.
Correct GO TO DEPENDING ON ordinal selection and fall-through.
Ensure all declared storage has correct initial state and scope.

latest_main_remeasurement.comparison: exact stdout bytes and process return code against GnuCOBOL
latest_main_remeasurement.note: Run 43592015588 evaluated current main 8ecabaaa7b50d01e9649814a989bbbac7491adef. Four complete contiguous 125-case shards (skip 500/625/750/875) form the exact deterministic 500-case slice equivalent to skip=500,target=500. All 500 IDs, source hashes and GnuCOBOL oracle fingerprints are complete; archive MD5 is verified. Score is 263/500. Compared with the prior main run 43578366403 (f2d944..., also 263/500), source hashes and IDs are identical; eight GnuCOBOL oracle fingerprints drifted, sq206a-3536dcf7c2 changed from fail to pass, and exec84-2-03eae98697 hit the 20-second translator timeout (20.0049s), leaving net score unchanged. The merged PR #375 candidate run 43579902217 passed both cases and scored 264/500 against the frozen pre-merge oracle; current main remains recorded at 263 until a fresh run confirms that timeout-boundary case. Main later advanced to bba24a11e20ba8fdb6cd234d7c20fd68c97ff22d with no translator blob change; no fresh benchmark was run on that exact commit.

last_tournament_attempt.note: Only 9 candidate holdout reports were available (seeds 1-8 and 16); the remaining candidates failed, were cancelled, or had missing reports. Seeds 1-8 scored 234-236/500 with 27-28 regressions each; seed 16 scored 155/500 with 113 regressions. No candidate was eligible and nothing was promoted.

Seeds 11-15 contain only workflow/documentation changes; they have no cobol2py.py or web/index.html translator change and no tests/reproducer change.

Seeds 1-10 and 16-30 contain translator and test changes, but all are stale and diverged. Seeds 16-30 also carry unrelated historical workflow/benchmark changes; do not treat these snapshots as isolated candidates.

The current-main PR tournament is the preferred active path: it freezes main's 500 per-ID GnuCOBOL fingerprints and compares candidate stdout hash, byte length and return code against that oracle. It runs daily at 11:30 UTC; the next scheduled execution after this main commit is 2026-11-15T11:30:00Z.

Open PRs 371-378 were measured against an older frozen baseline and target base f5b9534ddbbc13d3b30c00afd12c1611f7dece47. Their historical results are not promotion evidence against current main; the current-main tournament will skip any PR without a GitHub merge ref.

The 30-seed workflow is manual and refuses to proceed unless readiness is ready, all 30 branches are distinct and ahead-only, each has an isolated translator change plus tests, and all 30 full 500-case reports are complete and comparable.
